brgya bzhi bsdus pa btang bar 'dod na/zangs kyi sder ma gcig gi nang du/dbus su sāts+tsha lnga/shar du mda' dar lnga/lhor mar me lnga/nub tu zhal zas lnga/byang du

tei:div.tei:p: brgya bzhi bsdus pa btang bar 'dod na/ zangs kyi sder ma gcig gi nang du/ dbus su sāts+tsha lnga/ shar du mda' dar lnga/ lhor mar me lnga/ nub tu zhal zas lnga/ byang du pho glud mo glud bshams/ dar sna gos sna mi kha'i rdzas rnams 'dus phye bsur bcas bshams la chu gtsang gis bran la 'di skad do/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ sam+bha ra lan gsum/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ bde gshegs bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ lan gsum/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ lan gsum/ bcom ldan rin chen mang dang gzugs mdzes dang*// 'byams klas 'jigs kun bral la phyag 'tshal lo// bgegs chen bzhi dang stong phrag brgyad cu yis// lan chags bu lon sha 'khon thams cad la// so so'i yid la gang 'dod ster bar 'gyur// mchod sbyin glud gtor rgya chen po 'di bsngo zhing sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ bdag dang bsrung bya la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i lha'i bdud/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud/ phung po'i bdud/ 'chi bdag gi bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa rnams zhi zhing sgyur du gsol/ mo rtsis rmi lam ngan pa thams cad zlog cig /grangs bsags ni/ skabs dang bstun nas gsog /hūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bdud bzhi bdud kyi sder sogs pa'i// snang srid lha srin bgegs kyi tshogs// lan chags bdag po thams cad la// sāts+tsha brgya dang mar me brgya// zhal zas brgya dang ngar glud brgya// mdo tshar brgya dang chu gtor brgya// lha srin sde brgyad phyag tu 'bul// skyes pa za ma byis pa dang*// nor dang phyugs kyi glud du 'bul// sde brgyad zhal kha da sgyur cig /chag che nyam nga 'di yis zlog /oṃ a pa ra tsa tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na du tri sarba a pa na ye swā hā/ brgya bzhi 'di mkhas grub rā ga a s+yas mdzad pa'o/// /
